note: Reports of SPAX11 (TUBA4A p.Glu415Lys) note early or isolated upper vermian cerebellar changes on brain MRI, making the hypothesized temporal sequence biologically plausible for further testing.

evidence.text: Brain MRI in individuals with TUBA4A-related spastic ataxia showed questionable upper vermis atrophy.

source.title: A new genetic cause of spastic ataxia: the p.Glu415Lys variant in TUBA4A
source.quote: Brain MRI showed questionable upper vermis atrophy.
